criteria: Select by independently checked geometry and support behavior, not task score or ID.
description: Use native engine face contacts for polyhedra.
Cylinder side uses one reliable native witness. On cylinder cap (axial normal component dominates radial), use native multiple witnesses only if all normals agree with the single witness.
Cylinder detection is by geometric type and current contact normal. No case, mass, or outcome branches.
Plane-cylinder and other specialized analytic colliders retain their standard multipoint result.
limits: This changes the evaluated contact approximation, not mass, friction, actuators or task thresholds.
No real-world contact identification or general all-shape accuracy claim.
A cap with an inconsistent native manifold falls back to one point.
